title: DIGITAL round 2: choose the visual world
question: One world for Home, SIDEKICK, SHADES and BRAIN, built on the Apple product-page playbook and the two pieces your team liked. Keep the roll, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Signal Capture
options.thesis: Every build shown as a live capture: scroll is the timebase, each initiative a channel you can probe.
options.viewport: Dark graticule, one big dot orb drawn as a live trace, a 5-word headline, one action, mono cursor readouts naming three channels: SIDEKICK, SHADES, BRAIN.
options.risk: Can tip into test-equipment cosplay if mono labels multiply; the Apple word budget has to stay in charge.

raised.raise: State is line form, never hue: solid = live, dashed = pending, half-height = stale, struck = paused. Red stays the single trigger marker.
One vertical timebase rules every line of copy; each chapter sits at its own tick, like depth on a dive profile.
Each initiative carries a portable channel mark (CH1 SIDEKICK, CH2 SHADES, CH3 BRAIN) through the nav, page transitions and footer.
Each project page is single-subject: one object held on screen for the whole page.
One shared ground, and each channel gets its own signal behaviour: layers explode, light converges, the network wires.

options.label: Exploded Assembly
options.lineage: isometric assembly drawings with balloon callouts
options.thesis: Each build drawn apart on one sheet; scrolling separates the parts and names their owners.
options.viewport: A dark sheet with the build mid-explosion, numbered balloons on the right, headline and one action on the left.
options.risk: The most familiar choice: it's round 1's concept E grown into a whole site, so expect fewer surprises.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Every build shown as one frozen event: dots track outward through rings, one per subsystem.
options.viewport: A full-screen ring cross-section; dots burst from the centre and curve through the subsystem rings; one select-a-track control.
options.case: Fuses well: subsystems become rings, and the dot language becomes tracks. It matches the oscilloscope for engineering audiences but explains ownership less clearly. It also needs more colours than the single-red brand allows.
options.risk: Heavy WebGL, and the yellow/cyan track colours break the one-accent brand rule.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one calibrated rail; state is carried by line height and dash.
options.viewport: One off-centre rail with the open item blooming into a plate above it.
options.case: Students and sponsors don't recognise spectrographs, and it explains builds less clearly.
options.kept: State carried by line form, not colour.
options.risk: Too abstract for a recruiting page.

options.label: Mesophotic Dive
options.thesis: The page as a descent; each layer is a depth stage.
options.viewport: Turquoise surface fading to ink blue as you scroll.
options.case: A beautiful descent, but the ocean doesn't belong to a hardware club.
options.kept: One vertical axis rules every line of copy.

options.label: Livery Garage
options.thesis: Identity as a stripe system carried across every object.
options.viewport: A car's roundel anchoring the page.
options.case: Racing is a different club's identity, and stripes add colour the brand doesn't have.
options.kept: A portable mark per initiative, carried across pages.

options.label: Fansite Shrine
options.thesis: One long devoted column about one thing.
options.viewport: A centred table with a hit counter.
options.case: Undercuts the credibility sponsors look for.
options.kept: Single-subject devotion: one object per page.

options.label: Sleeping City Fold
options.thesis: Districts dream different weather under one night.
options.viewport: A city folding like a blanket.
options.case: Dreamlike softness fights an engineering story.
options.kept: One shared ground, a distinct behaviour per district.

canonCard.label: Apple product page, played straight
canonCard.thesis: Dark hero object, five-word headline, highlights carousel, closer-look viewer, one Join button.
canonCard.viewport: One big object on black, a short headline, one action.
canonCard.risk: Polished but interchangeable; it can also read as a fake Apple page.
